_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 declarative transitions revise, depreciateExtra and applyReinvestmentReserve with imperative action handlers that write schedule lines, imperative scheduled posting in DepreciationRunJob
_meta.description: Depreciation reaches the ledger: DepreciationRunJob posts each ended month's schedule lines, revise replans the unposted months from a date, depreciateExtra posts one extra line and replans, and a disposal gain can form a ReinvestmentReserve that a replacement asset applies. The schedule is the authority for an asset's monthly depreciation and book value once it exists, so the two time-based calculations that assumed the first plan are switched off and the schedule service writes both fields.

revisedMethod.title: New depreciation method
revisedMethod.description: The method from the revision date on. Leave empty to keep the current method.

revisedUsefulLifeMonths.title: New useful life (months)
revisedUsefulLifeMonths.description: The total useful life in months from acquisition, after the revision. Leave empty to keep the current life.

revisionDate.title: Revision date
revisionDate.description: The first day the new method or life applies. Months already posted from this date block the revision.

revisionReason.title: Revision reason
revisionReason.description: Why the method or useful life changes. Kept on the new schedule lines.

extraDepreciationAmount.title: Extra depreciation amount
extraDepreciationAmount.description: A one-off depreciation, posted at once.

extraDepreciationDate.title: Extra depreciation date
extraDepreciationDate.description: The date the extra depreciation is booked on.

extraDepreciationReason.title: Extra depreciation reason
extraDepreciationReason.description: Why the asset loses value at once.

disposalGainToReserve.title: Add the gain to a reinvestment reserve
disposalGainToReserve.description: On disposal, credit the gain to the reinvestment reserve account instead of profit, and keep it as a reserve for a replacement.

reinvestmentReserveId.title: Reinvestment reserve
reinvestmentReserveId.description: The open reinvestment reserve to apply to this asset.

reserveAmountApplied.title: Reserve amount applied
reserveAmountApplied.description: The part of the reserve applied to this asset. Leave empty to apply what is left of it, up to the asset's cost.

fiscalCostBasis.title: Fiscal cost basis
fiscalCostBasis.description: The acquisition cost less the reinvestment reserves applied to it; fiscal depreciation starts from this amount.

revise.label: Revise depreciation
revise.description: Change the method or useful life from a date. The unposted months from then on are planned again from the book value on that date; posted months stay as they are.

actions.description: Replan the unposted schedule lines from the revision date (ReviseDepreciationAction).

depreciateExtra.label: Extra depreciation
depreciateExtra.description: Book a one-off depreciation at once, then plan the remaining months from the lower book value.

actions.description: Post one extra schedule line and replan (ExtraDepreciationAction).

applyReinvestmentReserve.label: Apply reinvestment reserve
applyReinvestmentReserve.description: Lower this asset's fiscal cost basis with an open reinvestment reserve and debit the reserve account.

actions.description: Apply the reserve and post its journal entry (ApplyReinvestmentReserveAction).

status.title: Status
status.description: planned: not yet in the ledger; posted: in the ledger through the journal entry in glTransactionRef.

rateType.title: Rate Type
rateType.description: fixed-amount for a planned month, extra for a one-off extra depreciation.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the line was planned again or booked extra.

ReinvestmentReserve.title: Reinvestment reserve
ReinvestmentReserve.description: The gain on a sold asset kept for a replacement (art. 3.54 Wet IB 2001), applied to the replacement's fiscal cost or released to profit when its term ends.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The administration the reserve belongs to.

disposedAssetRef.title: Sold asset
disposedAssetRef.description: The asset whose disposal gain formed the reserve.

disposedAssetNumber.title: Sold asset number
disposedAssetNumber.description: The sold asset's number, kept for the overview.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The gain added to the reserve.

expiresOn.title: Expires on
expiresOn.description: The end of the third year after the year the reserve was formed. An unused remainder is released to profit then.

appliedAmount.title: Applied
appliedAmount.description: The part applied to replacement assets.

remainder.title: Remainder
remainder.description: The amount less what was applied.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Each replacement asset the reserve was applied to, with the amount and the journal entry.

reserveAccountNumber.title: Reserve account
reserveAccountNumber.description: The equity account the reserve is kept on.

releaseJournalEntryId.title: Release journal entry
releaseJournalEntryId.description: The journal entry that released the remainder to profit.

lifecycleState.title: State
lifecycleState.description: open: still available; applied: fully applied; released: the remainder went to profit at expiry.

remainder.description: Declarative (ADR-031): the amount less what was applied.

released.label: Released
released.description: The remainder was released to profit at expiry.

markApplied.label: Mark applied
markApplied.description: Set by the application when nothing remains.

release.label: Release
release.description: Set by the daily run when the reserve expires with a remainder.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Who formed, applied or released a reinvestment reserve, and when.
